title: R2007+ class-string footer atomic boundaries fast slice

researchBasis.source: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
researchBasis.formatRule: R2007+ class string-stream size words are bit-relative to the footer end bit; the low word high bit indicates an additional high-size word.
researchBasis.authority: ODA v5.4.1 is normative for DWG byte layout.

cases: Generated unextended 16-bit size-word form with exact start bit, size, and cursor.
Existing extended-size form at all seven nonzero footer bit offsets retained.
Overlong maximum extension preserves seeded caller outputs and a nonzero cursor on refusal.
Flagged low word with truncated high word refuses atomically.
Out-of-range footer preserves caller outputs and cursor.
